visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a sleeveless beige ruffled slip dress, stands on a wooden balcony at night. She looks towards the right side of the frame, smiling warmly with her mouth slightly open, and then reaches up to touch her hair with her left hand. The background is a dense, dark hillside illuminated by thousands of small yellow and white lights, creating a sparkling, festive atmosphere under a black sky. (2) The woman turns her back completely to the camera, facing the vast expanse of the illuminated hillside. She lifts both her arms high above her head in a triumphant or celebratory gesture, appearing to embrace the panoramic view. The lighting is low and warm, casting a soft glow on her shoulders and the dark wooden railing of the balcony in the immediate foreground. (3) She turns back around to face the camera, gracefully rotating her body while maintaining a bright, cheerful expression and looking directly at the lens. She performs a slight, rhythmic swaying motion, almost like a slow dance, while her hair flows naturally. The distant city lights continue to twinkle in the background, providing a consistent, high-contrast visual texture to the dark night scene.
